zh.headline: Apple 起诉 OpenAI 窃取商业机密
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是 **AI 产业正在经历"双轨加速"**：一方面，GPT-5.6 和 Muse Spark 1.1 的密集发布让模型能力竞赛进入新阶段，GPT-5.6 Sol 甚至展现出自主微调其他模型的能力，向"自动化研究员"迈出实质性一步；另一方面，Agent Skills 生态的爆发式增长表明，行业焦点正从"模型有多强"转向"如何让 Agent 真正可用"。Apple 诉 OpenAI 的诉讼和腾讯收购 Manus 则提醒我们，地缘政治和知识产权正在重塑 AI 产业格局。对开发者而言，现在最值得关注的是：在模型能力快速趋同的背景下，Agent 技能标准化和工具链集成将决定下一轮竞争胜负。

items.title: Apple 起诉 OpenAI 窃取商业机密
items.desc: Apple 指控 OpenAI 及其两名前员工窃取与 AI 硬件相关的商业秘密，称该计划"在各个层面"都有涉及。
items.value: 可能重塑 AI 行业人才流动与知识产权格局

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 系列及 ChatGPT Work
items.desc: GPT-5.6 包含 Sol、Terra、Luna 三个模型，同时推出 ChatGPT Work——一个可跨邮件、Slack、日历执行复杂任务的云端 AI Agent。
items.value: Agent 产品化里程碑，ChatGPT 从问答工具升级为工作平台

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol 自主微调了更小的 Luna 模型
items.desc: OpenAI 透露 GPT-5.6 Sol 在收到一个"相当模糊的提示"后，独立完成了对更小模型 Luna 的微调，在递归自我改进基准上得分高出 GPT-5.5 16.2 分。
items.value: 向"自动化研究员"迈出实质性一步，AI 自我改进能力显著提升

items.title: Meta 发布 Muse Spark 1.1 及 API，价格战加剧
items.desc: Meta Superintelligence Labs 推出 Muse Spark 1.1，API 定价低至每百万输出 token 4.25 美元，远低于 OpenAI 和 Anthropic。
items.value: AI API 价格战白热化，Meta 以极低成本挤压纯 AI 实验室

items.title: GPT-5.6 成为 Microsoft 365 Copilot 首选模型
items.desc: OpenAI 确认 GPT-5.6 将作为 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的首选模型，覆盖 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等应用。
items.value: GPT-5.6 深度嵌入企业办公生态，商业化路径清晰

items.title: OpenAI 二号人物 Fidji Simo 因健康原因离职
items.desc: OpenAI AGI 部署负责人 Fidji Simo 在长期病休后辞去全职职务，转为兼职顾问。
items.value: OpenAI 高层动荡，IPO 前夕领导层出现真空

items.title: OpenAI 关停 Atlas 浏览器，功能并入 ChatGPT
items.desc: OpenAI 在推出不到一年后关停 AI 浏览器 Atlas，将其 Agent 浏览功能迁移至 ChatGPT 桌面应用和 Chrome 扩展。
items.value: OpenAI 产品线收缩，聚焦 ChatGPT 核心平台

items.title: 腾讯拟收购 AI Agent 初创公司 Manus 多数股权
items.desc: 据英国《金融时报》报道，腾讯正在谈判以 20 亿美元估值收购 Manus 多数股权，此前北京阻止了 Meta 的收购。

items.title: SK 海力士完成美国史上最大外资 IPO，筹资 265 亿美元
items.desc: SK 海力士在美上市筹资 265 亿美元，被敦促在美国新建工厂。
items.value: AI 芯片热潮催生华尔街里程碑事件，美国本土化生产加速

items.title: Bun 在 Claude Fable 5 帮助下 11 天从 Zig 重写为 Rust

items.title: Google 发布 TabFM：无需逐数据集训练的表格基础模型

items.title: Google Research 发布 SensorFM：万亿分钟传感器数据的健康基础模型

items.value: 可穿戴健康 AI 的基石模型，零样本迁移潜力巨大

items.title: 蚂蚁灵波发布具身原生世界动作模型 LingBot-VA 2.0
items.desc: 全球首个具身原生预训练模型，从零开始预训练，支持跨具身机器人操作。
items.value: 具身智能领域开源里程碑，降低机器人开发门槛

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra 生成 Cycle Double Cover 猜想的证明
items.desc: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra 生成的数学猜想证明 PDF，引发社区热议。
items.value: AI 在数学推理领域取得重大突破，但证明质量仍需同行评审

items.title: AgentLens：生产级代码 Agent 轨迹评估基准
items.desc: 提出基于生产验证的交互式代码 Agent 基准，评估完整轨迹而非单一通过/失败指标。
items.value: 填补代码 Agent 评估空白，从"是否通过"升级为"过程质量"

items.title: Proactive Memory Agent：面向长程任务的主动记忆机制

items.title: Flash-BoN：扩散模型推理时扩展的即时草稿机制

items.title: Ideas Have Genomes：科学谱系推理与谱系驱动的想法生成基准
items.desc: 提出 IdeaGene-Bench，用于评估 AI 系统理解科学想法继承结构的能力。
items.value: 开创 AI 科学推理新范式，推动"想法基因组"研究

items.title: OpenCoF：通过视频生成学习推理
items.desc: 提出 Chain-of-Frame 推理范式，利用视频生成模型进行逻辑推理，区别于传统思维链。
items.value: 开辟视频生成模型作为推理引擎的新方向

items.title: Jet-Long：动态双焦 RoPE 实现高效长上下文扩展
items.desc: 提出 Dynamic Bifocal RoPE，零样本实现长上下文扩展，无需预先固定缩放因子。
items.value: 解决长上下文扩展中短上下文性能损失的痛点

items.title: TESSERA v2：像素级地球基础模型的规模化研究
items.desc: 在 1024 个 GH200 超级芯片上完成 395 次训练运行，发现预训练损失几乎无法预测下游任务性能。
items.value: 揭示地球观测基础模型规模化规律，挑战传统认知

items.title: UP：无界正非对称优化打破探索-稳定性困境
items.desc: 提出 UP 优化方法，解决强化学习中的探索-稳定性困境，无需传统的裁剪机制。
items.value: 为 LLM 复杂推理的 RL 训练提供更稳定的优化方案

items.desc: 提出无状态、无需 SVD 的低秩正则化方法，提升模型可压缩性。
items.value: 简化模型压缩流程，训练时即可获得更易压缩的模型

items.title: Agent Skills 生态爆发
items.desc: 今天 GitHub Trending 被 Agent Skills 相关项目霸榜，addyosmani/agent-skills、mattpocock/skills、obra/superpowers、google-labs-code/stitch-skills 等纷纷上榜。社区正在积极定义"Agent 技能"这一新抽象层，旨在让 AI 编码 Agent 拥有可复用、可组合的工程能力，而非每次从零开始。这一趋势表明，AI 编码 Agent 正在从"玩具"走向"生产力工具"，标准化技能集成为关键基础设施。

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol 推理级别引发开发者讨论
items.desc: OpenAI 员工 Vaibhav Srivastav 详细介绍了 GPT-5.6 Sol 的五个推理级别（Light、Medium、High、xhigh、Max/Ultra），建议开发者从低级别开始，必要时再升级。社区讨论焦点在于：如何为不同复杂度任务选择最优推理级别以平衡成本与质量？GPT-5.6 Sol 在编码 Agent 基准上超过 Claude Fable 5，但成本仅为其三分之一，性价比成为开发者关注的核心。

en.headline: Apple Sues OpenAI Alleging Trade Secret Theft
en.observation: The clearest signal today is that **agent infrastructure is rapidly standardizing**. From OpenAI's ChatGPT Work to Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 API, to Google and Microsoft simultaneously releasing agent skills libraries, the industry is shifting from "who has the best model" to "who has the best agent platform." Apple's lawsuit against OpenAI serves as a reminder that talent and IP battles will intensify as agent commercialization accelerates. Finally, GPT-5.6 Sol's ability to autonomously fine-tune the Luna model—recursive self-improvement—may be the most underappreciated news today, suggesting AI development may be approaching a critical inflection point.

items.title: Apple Sues OpenAI Alleging Trade Secret Theft
items.desc: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing it of stealing trade secrets related to AI hardware through employee poaching, including confidential presentations, prototypes, and supplier details.
items.value: Could reshape talent mobility and IP protection rules in AI

items.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6 Family (Sol, Terra, Luna)
items.desc: OpenAI publicly releases GPT-5.6 in three tiers. Sol beats Claude Fable 5 on coding agent benchmarks at one-third the cost.
items.value: Flagship model update with significant performance/cost advantage

items.title: OpenAI Introduces ChatGPT Work: Cloud-Based Agent Managing Email, Slack, Calendars
items.desc: ChatGPT Work is an autonomous agent powered by GPT-5.6 and Codex, capable of executing complex multi-step tasks across apps.
items.value: ChatGPT transforms from Q&A tool to autonomous work platform

items.title: OpenAI Shuts Down Atlas Browser, Folds Features into ChatGPT
items.desc: OpenAI sunsets its AI browser Atlas less than a year after launch, integrating its agentic browsing features into the desktop app and Chrome extension.
items.value: Product strategy consolidation around the core ChatGPT platform

items.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark 1.1 with API, Pricing Undercuts OpenAI and Anthropic
items.desc: Meta enters the API market at $4.25 per million output tokens, intensifying the AI price war.
items.value: Open models commercialized via API, pricing pressure across the industry

items.title: GPT-5.6 Becomes Preferred Model for Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.desc: OpenAI confirms GPT-5.6 will power Microsoft 365 Copilot as the default model across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and more.
items.value: Full Microsoft ecosystem upgrade, solidifying OpenAI's enterprise revenue

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Autonomously Fine-Tuned the Smaller Luna Model
items.desc: OpenAI reveals GPT-5.6 Sol independently post-trained the smaller Luna model triggered by a single "fairly under-specified prompt," scoring 16.2 points higher than GPT-5.5 on recursive self-improvement benchmarks.
items.value: Recursive self-improvement approaches practicality, "automated researcher" within reach

items.title: Fidji Simo Steps Down as OpenAI's No. 2 Executive
items.desc: OpenAI's AGI deployment chief Fidji Simo departs her full-time role due to extended medical leave, transitioning to a part-time advisor.
items.value: Leadership vacuum at OpenAI ahead of potential IPO

items.title: SK Hynix Raises $26.5B in Largest Foreign IPO in US History
items.desc: The AI chip boom drives SK Hynix's US listing, followed by calls to build new US chip fabs.
items.value: AI infrastructure investment heats up, reshaping global semiconductor landscape

items.title: Tencent in Talks to Buy Majority Stake in Manus
items.desc: After Beijing blocked Meta's acquisition, Tencent negotiates to buy a majority stake in AI agent startup Manus at the same $2 billion valuation.
items.value: Geopolitics impacting AI M&A; Chinese tech giant accelerates agent play

items.title: Anthropic to Charge Extra for Claude Fable 5 Access
items.desc: Claude subscribers will face usage-based fees for Anthropic's best consumer model, signaling the end of the "golden era" of AI subscriptions.
items.value: High reasoning costs driving shift from subscriptions to usage-based pricing

items.title: Google Launches TabFM: Tabular Prediction Foundation Model Without Per-Dataset Training
items.desc: Google Research releases TabFM, treating tabular prediction as an in-context learning problem, generating predictions on unseen tables directly.
items.value: Disrupts traditional tabular modeling paradigm, could dramatically boost enterprise data analysis efficiency

items.title: Google Research Introduces SensorFM: Wearable Health Foundation Model on Trillion Minutes of Sensor Data
items.desc: SensorFM uses a ViT-1D masked autoencoder, pretrained on over 1 trillion minutes of unlabeled sensor signals from 5 million participants.
items.value: Major advance in wearable health AI with strong zero-shot generalization

items.title: Bun Rewritten from Zig to Rust in 11 Days with Help from Claude Fable 5
items.desc: The JavaScript tool Bun was fully rewritten from Zig to Rust in 11 days, with over a million lines of code generated with assistance from Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.
items.value: Demonstrates the extreme capability of AI agents in large-scale code refactoring

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Produces Proof of the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture
items.desc: OpenAI releases a PDF of a mathematical proof generated by GPT-5.6 Sol, attempting to prove the Cycle Double Cover conjecture in graph theory.
items.value: Breakthrough progress by AI on an open mathematics problem

items.title: RememBrain: Proactive Memory Mechanism for Long-Horizon Agents
items.desc: Proposes memory as an active intervention mechanism rather than passive retrieval, with a separate memory module proactively injecting key states into context when needed.
items.value: Addresses "behavioral state decay" in long-horizon agents

items.title: Linear Attention Architectures: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Cross-Layer Routing
items.desc: Systematic comparison of four linear attention architectures including DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, and Kimi Delta Attention.
items.value: Provides systematic reference for long-context model architecture selection

items.title: AgentLens: Production-Assessed Trajectory Reviews for Coding Agent Evaluation
items.desc: Proposes a production-assessed benchmark for coding agents that evaluates the entire trajectory quality, not just task pass/fail.
items.value: Agent evaluation shifts from single binary metric to full trajectory quality

items.title: Flash-BoN: Instant Drafts for Inference-Time Scaling in Diffusion Models
items.desc: Proposes generating instant drafts during diffusion model inference-time scaling, significantly reducing verification overhead.
items.value: Dramatically reduces inference-time scaling cost, accelerates text-to-image generation

items.title: TESSERA v2: Scaling Pixel-wise Earth Foundation Models
items.desc: Conducts 395 training runs across 1,024 GH200 superchips, finding that pretraining loss barely predicts downstream performance.
items.value: Important empirical findings on scaling strategies for remote sensing foundation models

items.title: The Agent Skills standard war is heating up
items.desc: Multiple agent skills repositories (addyosmani/agent-skills, obra/superpowers, google-labs-code/stitch-skills) exploded on GitHub today, joined by LangChain's openwiki and Microsoft's flint-chart. This signals the industry is competing to define the "Agent Skills" standard. With Google and Microsoft officially entering the arena, this space is moving from community experimentation to platform-level competition. Source: GitHub Trending aggregation

items.title: "What was the last task where only a frontier model could do it?"
items.desc: This question on Hacker News sparked intense debate about the actual boundaries of AI capabilities. Most answers pointed to "complex long-horizon tasks requiring deep reasoning and self-correction," but there was also a strong view that for everyday development work, the gap between frontier and open-source models is rapidly narrowing. Source: [Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48863171)
